## Battle Pass Datapack
  This datapack adds an experience and reward system, based around breaking, placing blocks and killing mobs

### commands :

  /trigger pbp.help set 1 (doesn't require OP)
    opens a menu in chat where you can access options, see your current level and access the rewards

  /scoreboard players set $LvL100Lock pbp.BattlePass.levellock [0/1] (requires OP)
		0 = true, it locks the level at a 100 level cap (on by default)
		1 = false, it unlocks the level 100 cap and amps it up to a 200 level cap (off by default)
